name: install-dart
description: Azure Pipelines task that installs the Dart SDK on Windows, macOS, and Linux agents.

scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.json && esbuild build/tasks/InstallDart/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=tasks/InstallDart/dist/index.js && node scripts/render-logo.mts && node scripts/stage-extension.mts
scripts.package:raw: npm run build && tfx extension create --root build/extension --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path build/install-dart.vsix
scripts.package: npm run package:raw && node build/scripts/repack-vsix.js build/install-dart.vsix
